events.title: The new year begins with 폴 개스코인 being sent off in 토트넘 홋스퍼's 2–1 defeat at home to 맨체스터 유나이티드. 에버턴's resurgence under Howard Kendall continues with a 2–1 win at 첼시. 셰필드 유나이티드 make it three wins from four games but remain bottom of the table with a 1–0 home win over QPR. The biggest drama in the Second Division comes at Fratton Park , where 포츠머스 boost their survival hopes with a 5–1 home win over bottom club 헐 시티.
노팅엄 포리스트 beat 노리치 시티 6–2 at Carrow Road in the First Division.

The FA Cup third round produces a series of thrilling matches, perhaps the most notable being Second Division 웨스트브로미치 앨비언's 4–2 home defeat to non-league Woking . GM Vauxhall Conference title hopefuls 바닛 find themselves on the receiving end of a 5–0 defeat at home to 포츠머스. 첼시 suffer a shock 3–1 defeat at home to Second Division strugglers Oxford. 아스널 beat 선덜랜드 2–1 at Highbury, while 리버풀 are held to a 1–1 draw at 블랙번 로버스.

Fourth Division 번리 attract more than 20,000 fans to Turf Moor , where they see 맨체스터 시티 win the FA Cup third round tie 1–0. 반즐리 , hopeful of following their Second Division rivals Leeds into the First Division for the first time, attract a crowd of more than 22,000 to Oakwell to watch a 1–1 draw. Last season's beaten finalists 크리스털 팰리스 draw 0–0 with 노팅엄 포리스트.
맨체스터 유나이티드 begin their defence of the FA Cup with a 2–1 home win over QPR.

리버풀 sign winger Jimmy Carter from 밀월 for £800,000, on the same day that they beat 블랙번 로버스 3–0 in the FA Cup third round replay at Anfield to keep their hopes of a unique second double firmly on track. Brian Talbot is sacked as 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 manager following their shock FA Cup defeat.

In front of a smaller crowd than the one which saw them draw 1–1 at Oakwell three days ago, Leeds beat 반즐리 4–0 in the FA Cup third round replay at Elland Road. The other replays see Coventry beat 위건 애슬레틱 1–0 at Springfield Park and 윔블던 beat 애스턴 빌라 1–0 at Plough Lane .
34-year-old former England defender 비브 앤더슨 joins Second Division promotion chasers 셰필드 웬즈데이 on a free transfer from 맨체스터 유나이티드.

리버풀 remain top of the table but drop two points when they are held to a goalless draw at 애스턴 빌라. 아스널 miss the chance to go top when they are held to a goalless draw in the North London derby at White Hart Lane . Matthew Le Tissier and Rod Wallace score two goals each in 사우샘프턴's 4–3 win at Luton. 맨체스터 유나이티드 remain in the top five with a 3–0 home win over 선덜랜드.
에버턴 win 2–0 at Goodison Park in Howard Kendall's first match in charge against his old club 맨체스터 시티.
리버풀 sign 17-year-old midfielder Jamie Redknapp from 본머스 for £350,000.

리즈 유나이티드 beat 애스턴 빌라 4–1 in the FA Cup quarter final, while 사우샘프턴 take 맨체스터 유나이티드 to a replay with a 1–1 draw, while the clash between 첼시 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 also goes to a replay after the first match at Stamford Bridge ends in a goalless draw. In the only league action of the day, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's woes continue when they lose 4–2 at Brighton in the Second Division, a result which lifts the South Coast club into the playoff zone.
셰필드 유나이티드 pay a club record £450,000 for 크리스털 팰리스 midfielder Glyn Hodges , who played under Blades manager Dave Bassett several years ago when he was in charge at 윔블던.

아스널 go top of the First Division for the first time this season with a 1–0 home win over 에버턴, while 리버풀 (who still have a game in hand) can only manage a 1–1 draw at home to 윔블던. 크리스털 팰리스's title hopes are hit by a 3–1 home defeat to 노리치 시티.

첼시 go through to the League semi-finals with a 3–0 win their quarter-final replay at 토트넘 홋스퍼. 마크 휴스 scores a hat-trick for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in their 3-2 replay win over 사우샘프턴 at Old Trafford which takes them to this stage of the competition for the first time in eight seasons, while 20-year-old striker Alan Shearer scores twice for the losing side. 셰필드 웬즈데이 win 1–0 at Coventry in their delayed quarter-final tie.

The first FA Cup fourth round ties are played. Second Division promotion rivals 밀월 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 clash in South London and battle out a dramatic 4–4 draw. A South Coast clash sees 포츠머스 beat 본머스 5–1 at Fratton Park. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 볼턴 원더러스 1–0 at Old Trafford. The only First Division action of the day sees 셰필드 유나이티드 beat 더비 카운티 1–0 at Bramall Lane to boost their survival bid.
Woking's FA Cup dream comes to an end in the fourth round when they lose 1–0 to 에버턴 at Goodison Park . 아스널 and Leeds draw 0–0 in their fourth round clash at Highbury.
노팅엄 포리스트 beat 크리스털 팰리스 3–0 in their second FA Cup third round replay at the City Ground .
David Pleat is sacked after three years as manager of 레스터 시티 , the Second Division strugglers. His assistant Gordon Lee , the former 에버턴 manager, is placed in temporary charge.
리버풀 sign striker David Speedie from 코번트리 시티 for £675,000.

아스널 are one point ahead of 리버풀, who have a game in hand, at the top of the First Division. Meanwhile, 크리스털 팰리스 are still in contention for a first-ever league title, six points off the top, while 셰필드 유나이티드 remain bottom. 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 올덤 애슬레틱 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 continue to occupy the top three places in the Second Division. 노츠 카운티, 미들즈브러, Brighton and 밀월 occupy the playoff zone.
